body:
## 变更内容

- 插件支持中英文双语，自动跟随 VS Code 界面语言切换
- 英文界面下命令标题、配置说明、提示通知均显示英文
- 中文界面下显示中文，与之前保持一致

## 更新说明

- 新增 `src/localize.ts` 本地化模块
- 新增 `package.nls.json` / `package.nls.zh-cn.json` 多语言支持
- 所有用户可见字符串均已本地化

---

## Changes

- Added bilingual support (Chinese/English), automatically follows VS Code display language
- Command titles, config descriptions, and notifications show English in English UI
- Chinese UI displays Chinese, consistent with previous behavior

## Notes

- Added `src/localize.ts` localization module
- Added `package.nls.json` / `package.nls.zh-cn.json` for multilingual support
- All user-facing strings are now localized
